description: Current TikTok statistics, each as a quotable sentence with its value, year, scope and primary source (publisher, title, URL, date we checked it). Users, demographics, time spent, news use, engagement rates, formats, creator earnings and advertising. Pass a topic to narrow it down. Figures are re-checked regularly and come from platforms, public bodies and research institutes. Free to cite with a link to the page.

topic.description: Optional topic or question, for example 'engagement rate', 'teens' or 'creators earn'. Omit for the key statistics.
